close_reason: Added #[derive(Clone)] + manual Debug impl on SessionClient. Manual Debug redacts the inner JmapClient (which is intentionally non-Debug in locked jmap-base-client) and shows the Session. Callers can now embed SessionClient in their own #[derive(Debug)] wrappers. Workspace tests green. Commit 3d3ea6c.
description:
src/methods/mod.rs:232-235:
```
pub struct SessionClient {
    pub(crate) client: jmap_base_client::JmapClient,
    pub(crate) session: jmap_base_client::Session,
}
```

No derives at all. Both fields are likely to be Debug+Clone (JmapClient definitely is — `with_calendars_session` does `self.clone()` at lib.rs:36; Session is a serde-derived struct). User cannot:
- `#[derive(Debug)] struct MyApp { calendars: SessionClient }` (or has to manual Debug)
- Log a `SessionClient` for diagnostics
- Clone for parallel-tasks fan-out

Add `#[derive(Debug, Clone)]` if base types support it. Verify Clone is wanted (it is — lib.rs:36 already clones JmapClient inside with_calendars_session, so the pattern of cheap-clones is established).

Section: traits — missing-derives idiom. Audience: anyone integrating SessionClient into a larger application.
title: SessionClient missing Debug, Clone derives
